interpretation: The 300-frame validation subset selected depth/cutoff and best single; all 2,773 validation frames are descriptive and include that subset.
Test evaluations use two frozen selected choices; no test-driven retuning or selection.
Fingertip errors describe detected fingers with valid sensor references; F1/recall include misses and false positives.
Foreground and classification metrics use all positive-depth pixels; seven hand-class mean IoU excludes background from the class mean.
Official random frame splits do not establish subject/session independence.
The largest-connected-component detector versus adjusted sensor positions is our operational metric, not a reproduction of the HandNet paper mean-shift score.
Balanced-trained histograms are not established calibrated probabilities; no temporal accuracy, latency or GPU/mobile/FPGA inference claim.
Any subsequent 200m/256 comparison after these outcomes is post-exposure exploratory engineering, not independent untouched confirmation.
